operations: Retain first 20 seconds without detecting phrase boundaries
Produce one channel of signed 16-bit PCM in a WAV container
transformation.crossVersionReproducibilityNote: Other ffmpeg versions/builds may produce different resampling bytes; retain the supplied fixture hash as the test-data identity

limitations: No exact performed transcript or word/line boundaries have been manually verified
The 20-second crop may end mid-word or mid-phrase
Empty expectedAnchors must keep the current opt-in real-model harness fail-closed before any model load
The WAV container cannot be used as the harness's raw float32 little-endian pcmFile
No singing-recognition or lyric-alignment quality claim has been validated
One recording and one language do not establish multilingual or singer-generalization accuracy
